$description: Button component tokens — the shape of every `.l-button`: plain buttons, `l-button-group` and `.l-radio-group` segments, and the actions `l-alert-dialog` renders in its shadow root. Colors stay on the button's own `--background-color` / `--border-color` knobs and the semantic aliases behind them; these tokens carry the geometry a theme changes globally.

border-radius.$description: Corner radius of every button, at every size. Follows --l-form-control-border-radius by default (--l-radius-md, 6px), so a button and the text field beside it share one corner — and a theme that reshapes --l-radius-md reshapes both. Set it on its own to decouple buttons from fields: `0` for square buttons, `var(--l-radius-full)` for pills. Segmented groups (`l-button-group`, `.l-radio-group` with the button appearance) square off the inner corners whatever the value.

border-width.$description: Border width of every button. Follows --l-form-control-border-width by default, so a button keeps the same edge as the text field it sits next to (input group, toolbar, form actions). Segmented groups (`l-button-group`, `.l-radio-group` with the button appearance) overlap their neighbours by this width, so the shared border stays single. Set it on its own to decouple buttons from fields.
